A_original_runtime_reproduction.peer_objection_resolution: Refuted as a cross-turn comparison. The driver writes report.failure_observation after the opening, overwrites it after the same-conversation follow-up, and overwrites it again after the post-reload turn. At run completion it describes the post-reload reply. Its answerMatchesPublicStages=false and answerStagesInOrder=false are computed against Capture/Understand/Use even though that turn asks for a code and heading. receipt.chat.answer_names_page_stages=true and answer_stages_in_order=true describe the separately checked opening turn. The final diagnostic's latestAssistantReply names the codes and heading, and mentions the workflow stages only as location context; no stage-order answer was required for that prompt.
